verification.notes: Some contemporaneous reporting said Trump believed Bondi tipped off Eric Swalwell and that this contributed to her removal. Acting Attorney General Blanche said only Trump knew the reason, and Swalwell denied Bondi tipped him off. The allegation existed, but the causal claim remains unconfirmed.
